title: Anniversary Downgrade Test: Review Spend Against the Review Threshold
content:
**Ship-To Fulfillment Account — service level review standard, the downgrade test.**

### Section 1. Outcome of the review

For the anniversary review of a ship-to, and only for that review, a ship-to that shipped merchandise on shipped order lines within the 12 months before the review date and whose review spend is below its review threshold moves down one service level, and every other ship-to keeps its level at the review, a ship-to with no such merchandise being left to the inactivity suspension; a move up on the customer's request remains under the rule for requested moves.

### Section 2. Quantities

1. **Review spend.** The review spend is the twelve-month spend: the extended amount of the ship-to's shipped order lines and backorder fill lines dated within the 12 months before the review date, less the credit amount of its received return lines dated within the same 12 months, a line being within N months when fewer than N whole months separate its date from the review date.
2. **Whole months.** Whole months between two dates are the difference in calendar months between them, less one where the day of the month of the later date is smaller than the day of the month of the earlier date.
3. **Six-month spend.** The six-month spend is the same shipped and filled merchandise less return credits over the lines within the 6 months of the review date.
4. **Counted figures.** Where a share below full is set for a kind of merchandise, the uncounted part of that merchandise is taken out of the twelve-month and the six-month spend, each over its own months, giving the counted twelve-month and counted six-month figures (equal to the twelve- and six-month spend where every kind counts in full); the counted figures are formed first, and the review spend is then formed from them.
5. **Review threshold.** The review threshold is the downgrade spend percent of the level the ship-to holds (the downgrade spend percent column of the service level schedule) of the entry gate spend of that level, the entry gates being:

| Level held | Entry gate spend (USD) |
|---|---|
| Corbett Parcel Ship-To | 0.00 |
| Corbett Standard Ship-To | 5000.00 |
| Corbett Priority Ship-To | 25000.00 |
| Corbett Route Delivery Ship-To | 60000.00 |
| Corbett Premier Route Ship-To | 150000.00 |
| Corbett Dedicated Delivery Ship-To | 500000.00 |

### Section 3. Moving down one level

Moving down one service level takes Corbett Dedicated Delivery Ship-To to Corbett Premier Route Ship-To, Corbett Premier Route Ship-To to Corbett Route Delivery Ship-To, Corbett Route Delivery Ship-To to Corbett Priority Ship-To, Corbett Priority Ship-To to Corbett Standard Ship-To and Corbett Standard Ship-To to Corbett Parcel Ship-To, and a Corbett Parcel Ship-To keeps its level.

### Section 4. Comparison

The review spend and the review threshold are compared to the cent, without rounding either figure. Only a review spend below the threshold moves the ship-to down; a review spend equal to the threshold keeps the level.

### Worked example (hypothetical figures)

A ship-to holding Corbett Standard Ship-To, with a downgrade spend percent of 60 read from the schedule for that level: the review threshold is 60 percent of 5000.00, that is 3000.00. In the 12 months before the review date its shipped order lines total 2400.00, its backorder fills 300.00 and its received return credits 150.00.

| Figure | Amount |
|---|---|
| Twelve-month spend (2400.00 plus 300.00 less 150.00) | 2550.00 |
| Review spend | 2550.00 |
| Review threshold | 3000.00 |
| Result | below the threshold and merchandise shipped in the window: moves down to Corbett Parcel Ship-To |

Had its review spend been exactly 3000.00 it would keep Corbett Standard Ship-To. Had it shipped no merchandise on shipped order lines in the 12 months, it would keep its level at the review and be left to the inactivity suspension.
